description: This award celebrates high voter variance, that is, images which have split the crowd. The award was originally suggested by another user, and can be read about [here](https://www.dpchallenge.com/image.php?IMAGE_ID=1000203). As opposed to many other awards, this is deterministic and is awarded to the user that received the highest vote variance amongst the submissions.
name: Asigmatic

description: I've wanted to create an award like those in the posthumous thread. So this is the "bluebird of happiness" award. If goes to pictures that I think are wonderful, help me see things in a different way, or ones that simply make me smile.
